name.en-US: foxprefs — your preferences for AI agents

summary.en-US: Keep your sizes, diet, budget, travel and hard rules in one place in your browser. Copy them for any AI agent, and choose for each one: share it, ask first, or keep it private.

description.en-US:
foxprefs keeps typed preferences that any AI agent can read on your terms. You type "size M, vegetarian, no red-eye flights, never over 200 USD" once, instead of in every chat.

**Who it is for:** people who use AI agents for shopping, travel or writing, and developers who build those agents.

**What it does**

- The settings page has fields for you, shopping, food, travel, budget, how agents answer you, accessibility and hard rules. Each value is checked: a size that does not exist or an amount with no currency is refused, with a message under the field.
- Each field has a level. Public: in the text you copy for an agent. Ask: only after you approve it in foxscope. Private: never leaves this browser.
- "Copy for an agent" copies your public preferences and hard rules as short text to paste into an agent's instructions.
- "Fill my size" in the toolbar popup sets the size menus on the page you are on, only when you click it.
- Export and import move your preferences as a JSON file.

**What leaves your computer:** nothing. foxprefs has no server and no analytics. It answers one other add-on, foxscope (foxscope@pooriaarab), which runs in this browser and asks you before it shares an "ask" field. Every other add-on gets no answer.

**Permissions**

- Storage: keep your preferences in this browser.
- Active tab and scripting: "Fill my size" sets the size menus on the current tab after you click the button. foxprefs does not read pages at any other time.

The source code is MIT licensed.

version.approval_notes: The uploaded source.zip is the git tree of this release. To build: install Node 24 and pnpm 11 (corepack enable), run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build:ext`. The output is dist-ext/. esbuild bundles extension/*.js with src/; the other files are copied unmodified. To try it: open the add-on preferences, set a top size and a diet, then press "Copy for an agent". To try "Fill my size", open a shop page with a size menu and press the button in the toolbar popup. onMessageExternal answers only the sender foxscope@pooriaarab. No account is needed.
